messages.summary:
## Objective
- Continue and complete the existing “LAST LIGHT” game as a complete, playable browser game.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game directly in the existing single-file `index.html`, using canvas rendering without external game libraries.
- Added a battle-royale loop with bots, combat, loot, a shrinking safe zone, desktop and touch controls, HUD, and replay flow.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable gameplay, canvas island scene, bot AI and combat, loot pickup, zone damage, minimap, health/armor/ammo HUD, end screen, keyboard/mouse controls, and mobile controls in `index.html`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check` and whitespace with `git diff --check`.
- Tested the title and gameplay in Chromium at desktop and mobile sizes; desktop gameplay screenshot showed the game, and browser console had zero errors after start.
- Latest checked screenshot: `/tmp/opencode/last-light-final.jpg`.

### Active
- No active work reported.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. If further work is requested, inspect `index.html` and continue from the current playable implementation.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game UI, CSS, rendering, and gameplay implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status` showed `M index.html`.
- A local HTTP server was started in tmux on port `3002` for browser testing.

Completed the existing **LAST LIGHT** browser game in `index.html` with the battle-royale loop, combat, loot, shrinking safe zone, HUD, desktop/touch controls, and replay flow.

I also fixed two gameplay issues: bots were taking duplicate damage outside the safe zone, and late-game bots could remain alive with depleted health, preventing the match from ending.

**Checks:** JavaScript syntax and `git diff --check` pass. The previously checked desktop/mobile browser tests and the latest 1280×720 JPEG at `/tmp/opencode/last-light-final.jpg` are retained.

**Assumption:** Kept the existing single-file, canvas-based implementation. Changes remain uncommitted.
